mcqs.question: In the September 2025 proceedings concerning the Pramati judgment, which issue was specifically linked to the applicability of the Right to Education framework to minority schools?
options: Applicability of the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) to minority schools
Reservation of 25% entry-level seats in private unaided schools
Recognition of minority languages in school education
Appointment of teachers only through the Central Government
mcqs.explanation: The issue linked to the Pramati judgment was the applicability of the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) to minority schools. The 25% reservation of entry-level seats is a separate provision under Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act.

mcqs.question: Under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act, 2009, what provision applies to private unaided schools?
options: 25% of entry-level seats for disadvantaged groups, with reimbursement by the State
25% of all seats for minority students, without State reimbursement
6% of entry-level seats for disadvantaged groups, with reimbursement by the State
33% of entry-level seats for women, with reimbursement by the State
mcqs.explanation: Section 12(1)(c) provides 25% of entry-level seats in private unaided schools for disadvantaged groups, with the State providing reimbursement. The alternatives change the beneficiaries, percentage or reimbursement arrangement.
